The Swagger UI HTML page is produced by the `get_swagger_ui_html` function, defined in `fastapi/openapi/docs.py`.

It builds the HTML that loads Swagger UI (embedding the `openapi_url`, title, CDN URLs for `swagger-ui-bundle.js`/`swagger-ui.css`, OAuth2 redirect URL, and swagger UI parameters) and returns it as an `HTMLResponse`.

This function is invoked internally by `FastAPI.setup()` in `fastapi/applications.py`, where the `swagger_ui_html` route handler (registered at `self.docs_url`, default `/docs`) calls `get_swagger_ui_html(...)` to generate the response for the `/docs` endpoint.
